subject.title: Feature: allow account switching from /models buttons for GPT and Claude

question: Should `/models` grow a first-class cross-channel account/profile selector for provider-backed models, and what shared contract should Discord, Telegram, and future channel pickers implement?
rationale: The lower-level auth-profile machinery exists, but the visible UX, persistence semantics, compatibility with `/model ...@profile`, and channel callback encoding are product and upgrade-policy choices.

options.title: Define shared picker contract
options.body: Add a shared account/profile picker model consumed by supported channel pickers, including compatible profile lists and active-profile display.

options.title: Keep typed commands only
options.body: Keep `/model ...@profile`, `/model status`, and auth-order commands as the supported account-switching path and close or defer picker UX work.

options.title: Pilot one channel first
options.body: Approve a narrower Discord or Telegram experiment while documenting that other channel pickers stay unchanged until the shared contract is accepted.

recommendation.title: Define shared picker contract
recommendation.body: Add a shared account/profile picker model consumed by supported channel pickers, including compatible profile lists and active-profile display.

likelyOwner.reason: The history sample points to steipete as the broadest owner across shared model picker, provider identity, and session override surfaces.
